parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more specific, actionable steps (concrete tickers like VGIT/VTIP/SCHD/VIG, explicit rebalancing rules, and quantified trims) and grounds recommendations more tightly in the user's portfolio and sequence-of-returns risk relevant to a 10-year pre-retiree. System A introduces some weaker factual claims (e.g., overstated monthly surplus math, generic dividend picks) and its healthcare-trim rec somewhat conflicts with its own dividend-income rec, whereas B's recommendations are more internally coherent.
